hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/codorus-state-park/stay ('Electric hookups: Available at many sites') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880316 (59 public sites list 50-amp, 50 list 30-amp; the 31 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 182 campsites on the booking site (93 Modern Electric, 58 Modern Non-Electric, 31 Full-Hookup), 15 of them tent-only; DCNR says 'About 180 campsites for tents or RVs (up to 50 ft)'. The booking site's per-site max vehicle lengths run mostly 43-53 ft, a few to 58; every RV site is listed back-in. Pets on designated sites for a fee.

sites.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/codorus-state-park/stay ('Sites: About 180 campsites for tents or RVs (up to 50 ft)', 'Tent-only sites: 15') + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/codorus-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880316 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). 'Maximum 14 consecutive nights between Memorial Day and Labor Day; equipment must be removed for 48 hours before returning.'

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/codorus-state-park/stay (Stay limits) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/codorus-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880316 (Booking Window for Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night summer max; season already manual (mid-April through November 1, which DCNR still states). Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 31 full-hookup sites, 182 campsites up to 50 ft (DCNR; RA lists a few to 58), all back-in, showers/flush toilets/dump. Not stated for this park: the Saturday 2-night summer minimum, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
